posts.title: A Doorway into Deeper Reading
posts.description: As with any literature, the Bible makes substantial use of metaphor, simile and many other techniques common to writings of the ancient world. If we read these in a baldly literal fashion or as mere literary flourishes, we will miss the point. They often carry significant meaning and theological freight with them.
